<thought>Using the template with ID 29646 on the given molecule produced three possible protected products. For each product, the corresponding silyl chloride reagent (TBDMSCl) is a required precursor. Therefore the precursor sets are each protected SMILES together with the SMILES for TBDMSCl (Cl[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C).</thought>
